title: Support-coverage estimation

problem.name: Support-coverage estimation
problem.statement_latex: For a finite distribution $p$ and integer $t$, estimate $S_t(p)=\sum_i(1-(1-p_i)^t)$, the expected number of distinct values in $t$ independent draws, to additive error $\varepsilon t$. Access is via a coherent sampler.
